periods.time: Seven Stars B-block first-round special match
periods.label: 不转杀手与完全反射

status.current: defeated by Stella and later medically unable to continue

personality.summary: Violent, prideful and murder-trained; she treats public matches as kill missions once permission is implied.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Enemy who enrages her by proposing four-on-one; Stella defeats her by punching through reflected damage.
relationships.reisen-hiraga: Akatsuki supervisor who authorizes lethal force in the match.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Temporary teammate; she coordinates with Rinna's Beast King's Intimidation to first knock Stella out of bounds.
relationships.kanata-totokubara: Former opponent during Hagun attack; Kanata could not scratch her because of Complete Reflection.

periods.summary: Tatara is identified by Kanata and Touka as a reflection specialist, a disastrous matchup for Stella's overwhelming attack power. In the four-on-one match she tries to kill Stella with her chainsaw Device Ground Centipede and relies on Complete Reflection to punish any counterblow. Her assassin training lets her read Stella's feint and reflect the true liver punch, shattering Stella's left wrist. Tatara's miscalculation is that Stella accepts the reflected injury and completes the punch anyway, crushing Tatara's abdomen and consciousness in one decisive blow. She is later ruled unable to continue, contributing to Stella's direct B-block advance.

key_events.summary: Kanata warns Touka that Tatara is a reflection mage whom even Kanata could not damage.
Fights Stella first and loses despite successfully reflecting Stella's punch.
